outcome: placental inflammatory expression (ACE-2, TMPRSS2, IFN-g, IL-6)
cohort: The study included 32 placenta samples from pregnancies with symptomatic third-trimester maternal COVID-19 infection and 32 placenta samples from normal non-COVID-19 pregnancies.
finding: Symptomatic third-trimester maternal COVID-19 infection was associated with higher placental expressions of TMPRSS2 and IFN-g, increased trophoblast and stromal apoptosis, and the presence of SARS-CoV-2 spike protein in 25% of placental samples, indicating placental disturbance, with no correlation between maternal COVID-19 severity and placental inflammation or apoptosis.
